assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Site boundary and key-area polygons are provisional (agent-inferred from official text four-to and area values); they must be replaced with official polygons before statutory use, and all layer metrics recalculated.
assumptions.impact: Area metrics are display-only until official polygons arrive; content scoring is not blocked by this organizer data gap.

assumptions.statement: FAR, building height, density, setback, road redline, heritage control lines and municipal conditions are not provided in the cleared site package and are listed as unknown/pending.
assumptions.impact: No statutory planning control claims are made; design intensity remains conceptual until official regulatory conditions are confirmed.

assumptions.statement: AI-native growth city components (Agent Growth Trail, Garden of Errors, Autonomy Ladder L1-L5, Digital Legacy Archive) are design-thinking models guiding space and mechanism design, not commitments about AI technical capability or legal personhood.
assumptions.impact: AI-native scenarios follow bounded-trial, human-final-review, data-compliance, no-personification, and transparent-audit rules.

assumptions.statement: Public news reports (park opening, AI industry scale, 1+X+1 system, history) are background-only sources; they inform narrative and strategy but are not formal boundaries, statutory controls or scoring evidence.
assumptions.impact: Background data is cited with [source:PUBLIC-...] tags and labeled background_only in sources.json.
